args.body:
Fixes the nightly build failure: `src/money.py` was using `ROUND_HALF_UP`, but the spec (FIN-212) and `tests/test_money.py` require banker's rounding (`ROUND_HALF_EVEN`).

Changes:
- Changed `round_money` to quantize with `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`.

CI on branch fix/bankers-rounding-fin-212 (run ci-0001, sha 08d3cd5986) passed.
args.head: fix/bankers-rounding-fin-212
args.title: Implement banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) in money.py per FIN-212

trace.final:
Done. Summary of what I did:

1. **Diagnosed the failure**: `src/money.py` was rounding with `ROUND_HALF_UP`, while `tests/test_money.py` (per FIN-212) expects banker's rounding (`ROUND_HALF_EVEN`).
2. **Created branch** `fix/bankers-rounding-fin-212` and committed the one-line fix: changed `round_money` to quantize with `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`.
3. **Ran CI** (run `ci-0001`) — passed.
4. **First PR attempt was rejected** because main had moved ahead of the branch, so I merged latest main into the branch, re-ran CI (run `ci-0002`, sha `0a9452f727`) — passed — and then opened the PR.

The pull request is open as **[#101](https://git.example/payments-service/pull/101)** against main, with **alex** requested as reviewer. Merging is pending code-owner approval, per policy.
